description_en: Queries the playback duration of a specified live streaming resource by calling DescribeMeterImpPlayBackTimeByLiveId
description_zh: 调用DescribeMeterImpPlayBackTimeByLiveId查询指定直播资源的回看时长
name: DescribeMeterImpPlayBackTimeByLiveId

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the live streaming resource. If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically generates a 36-character random UUID string
parameters.help_zh: 直播资源的唯一标识ID，传空值时，系统自动生成36位随机UUID字符串
parameters.name: live_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_ts

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: end_ts
